Subject: POC Trial: Success Criteria & KPIs - Recap + Next Steps

Hi Sofia / Ethan 

Great conversation earlier  thanks for walking us through the primary objectives for Atlas Payments. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed success criteria, evaluation plan, and immediate next steps so we have a single reference for the POC/trial. Please reply with any changes.

POC scope (summary)
- Integrate Redwood inference into the payments support pipeline for: 1) automated categorization + 2) customer response suggestions.
- Test window: 2 weeks of live traffic replay + 1 week of shadowing (configurable).

Proposed Success Criteria / KPIs
1) Latency: p95 inference latency <= 350 ms for production-sized requests (actual request size ~ 512 tokens).
2) Throughput: support sustained 30 requests/sec (concurrent) with auto-batching; no more than 10% degraded responses under peak replay.
3) Cost: average cost/token <= $0.0008 for served traffic during trial (including batching benefits).
4) Quality: automated correctness/acceptance > 92% across 500 golden test prompts (customer-labeled), and <5% hallucination rate on sampled replies.
5) Operational: end-to-end error rate < 0.5% and no critical (>5 min) outages during trial window.

Evaluation plan
- Dataset & tests: Atlas supplies 500 labeled golden prompts + 5 days of anonymized production replay (PII scrubbed). Redwood provides an evaluation harness and latency/throughput scripts.
- Ownership: Atlas PM (Sofia) owns golden prompts + acceptance; Redwood AE (Jordan) owns delivery schedule; Redwood SE (Marissa) owns integration/infra.
- Measurements: we will report p50/p95 latency, tokens-per-second, cost/token, and quality pass rate daily to the shared Drive dashboard.

Timeline (proposed)
- Feb 17: Kickoff + environment access provided (Atlas to share dataset + API keys)
- Feb 18-20: Integration + smoke runs
- Feb 21-26: 2-week replay window + continuous monitoring
- Feb 27: Final results, runbook + recommendations

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC plan & checklist), latency-kpi-template.xlsx (template we will use to log KPIs).

Immediate next steps
- Sofia: share anonymized replay data and golden prompts (by EOD Feb 16)
- Marissa: will draft integration checklist and request infra access details
- Jordan: schedule kickoff for Feb 17 (proposed 10 AM PT)

Thanks  happy to iterate on any of the targets above.

Best,
Jordan Blake

Thanks Jordan  this is helpful and matches our internal notes. A few tweaks from our side:
- Latency: target p95 <= 400 ms (we expect some variability with our larger payloads; happy to reassess after smoke run).
- Throughput: we'll validate at 25 req/sec initially and scale to 30 req/sec if smoke runs look good.
- Quality: 92% acceptance is fine; would like to add a loose customer satisfaction proxy (CSAT survey sent to a random 100 users for human-rated responses).

We will:
- Share anonymized replay and the 500 golden prompts by EOD Feb 16 (security is confirming scrubbed logs).
- Provide temporary API keys and a test environment for Redwood by Feb 17 morning.

Also can you share a SOC2 evidence packet or our security questionnaire? Our procurement team will need that before we move infra-level access.
